name: Trouble Twins -My Sweet Brothers-
original_name: とらぶるツインズ －MY SWEET BROTHERS－
source:
Main character is a mischievous student who has a calm twin sister  studying in the same school. Personalities are very different, so siblings fight all the time. But one day parents go overseas for two weeks, so young people need to cooperate. Every day is a big fuss at home, and school bullies add to the chaos.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名调皮的学生，就读的学校里还有性格沉稳的双胞胎姐姐。二人性格截然不同，因此总是争吵。某天，父母要出国两周，姐弟俩不得不合作。家中每天都闹得不可开交，学校里的恶霸又使局面更加混乱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
